Ami (CSM): FYI Hawthorn Retail just pinged — three new product squads (store search, returns automation, and shelf restock alerts) want to ramp this quarter, looks like an org-level push.
Ravi (AM): Nice, what's the signal? usage or roadmap ask?
Ami (CSM): Usage. Over the past 48h we saw a sustained 6x increase in requests for their test env. Eng telemetry shows spikes hitting ~180 req/s during peak tests. Customer says they'd go prod if we can guarantee latency <200ms for chat flows.
Noah (Product): Are they asking for new model features or just more capacity?
Ami (CSM): Both — embeddings for ranking + chat responses with tool calling. They've asked about dedicated capacity and prioritization for low-latency routing.
Sophie (Eng): 180 req/s is fine for hosted across multiple smaller instances, but latency SLOs and KV cache warmups could be a problem for cold starts. Recommend a short dedicated pilot (2-4 GPUs) or configured burst reserve while we validate traffic shape.
Sophie (Eng): Also need to capture token sizing — if their chat requests average 600 tokens per request that changes cost/throughput math.
Ami (CSM): I asked them for sample prompts and average lengths. They said median ~450 tokens, peak ~1k.
Ravi (AM): Renewal for them is in 9 weeks — this expansion could be a great upsell but also a risk if latency/quality suffers. Let's prioritize.
Noah (Product): Can we pair an enablement session for the PMs + engineers to align expectations and capture feedback? Suggest a live runbook + short eval prompts to watch for quality regressions.
Ami (CSM): I'll set up a 60-min enablement next Tue. Who should lead the technical portion?
Sophie (Eng): I can run the tech demo. I'll include quick ops notes: cache priming, batch sizing, and suggestions for prefix caching.
Ami (CSM): Great. Also capturing feedback — customer wants per-route latency and token-cost breakdowns. Can we surface that in Console?
Sophie (Eng): Yes — we can add a per-route dashboard for them and enable trace sampling for 72h. Would need a ticket to ops to bump retention for that account.
Ravi (AM): I'll open the ops ticket and loop Legal if we need an updated SLA for dedicated capacity.
Ami (CSM): Heads-up @deploy-bot — can you confirm available dedicated pilot capacity next Monday?
deploy-bot: Confirmed: 2x A100 pilot slots available Mon-Fri next week in us-west-2 (subject to booking). Slots expire in 48h if not reserved.
Sophie (Eng): Book them for Wed morning tentative. I'll prepare a canary config:
```
# canary config
model_variant: "redwood-medium-quant"
replicas: 2
burst_pool: 1
latency_slo_ms: 200
trace_sampling: 0.05
```
Ami (CSM): Next steps: 1) I schedule enablement (Ami) 2) Ops ticket for retention + pilot slot reservation (Ravi) 3) Canary config + runbook (Sophie) 4) Collect sample prompts/lengths from Hawthorn (Ami) 5) Prepare renewal upsell note if pilot looks good (Ravi).
Noah (Product): Add a quick feedback form for Hawthorn to capture quality regressions tied to eval prompts. Link to shared doc: https://redwood-internal/notes/hawthorn-feedback (Ami please add initial prompts).
Ami (CSM): Will do. Also flagged potential renewal risk if latency >250ms for >10% of requests. Marking as priority-high in our tracker.
Ravi (AM): Thanks team. Ami — ping me when the enablement is scheduled and I'll prepare commercial options for dedicated vs reserved burst.
Ami (CSM): Will update thread after enablement. :thumbsup:
